elements.label: Field type dropdown list (scrolling)
elements.text: Multi-select / Number / People / Rating / Reactions / Select / Short text / Slider / DYNAMIC FIELDS / Custom formula / Vote

elements.label: Mouse cursor moving down the options

pattern.description: The open Field type dropdown scrolls its option list inside the fixed menu while the cursor hovers down through the standard field types; the hover highlight follows the cursor and the Dynamic fields and Insights groups scroll into view.
pattern.why_premium: Scrolling inside a fixed menu keeps the form and table anchored while revealing the breadth of field types in under a second, matching the narration 'choose from a standard field type'.

build_hint.gsap: Overflow-hidden menu; gsap.to(optionList, {y: -scrollDistance, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power2.out'}) with the scrollbar thumb tweened on the same progress; cursor gsap.to(cursor, {y: '+=270', duration: 0.6, ease: 'power1.inOut'}); hover highlight bar repositioned per row with gsap.set or a 0.08s fade.
build_hint.remotion: List translateY = interpolate(frame, [0, 20], [0, -scrollDistance], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}) inside overflow:hidden; thumb y mapped from the same progress; highlighted row index derived from cursor y each frame.

notes: Screen recording (wheel scroll in steps, visible as two energy bursts). b01 is the union box; it covers the dropdown header and the upper list but not the lowest rows (Insights, Pendo for Polaris).
